posts.title: For sale: Clausing Kondia FV-1 CNC mill
posts.text: Selling my Clausing Kondia FV-1 CNC mill, because I stumbled into a newer Haas mill, and don't have space to keep both. posts.title: Wanted: Hobby Machinist with Metal Lathe — Small, Simple Paid Project
posts.text: Looking for someone with a metal lathe to make a small set of cylindrical metal parts for a mechanical puzzle. The work involves basic lathe operations: cutting 1 inch Al stock to length, turning outside diameters, and drilling axial holes. No CNC equipment required. A conventional manual metal lathe should be sufficient. This is a small, one-time project, may lead to more, particularly suitable for a retired machinist, home-shop hobbyist, or someone who enjoys straightforward... Read more
